verdict.rationale: Per-PR preview deployments are a fair question for a serverless deploy platform like Workers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents automatic preview URLs for pull requests. The closest items are general Git/GitHub Actions compatibility, a Workers Builds MCP server, and version rollbacks, and none of them describes per-PR preview URLs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request
